desc: Implement DSU with path compression and union by size/rank.
Map each input value to its node index and initialize every node as an independent component.
Enumerate multiples of each input value `x <= threshold`, union values sharing a multiple via a representative array.
Verify that sharing a common multiple no greater than `threshold` is equivalent to `lcm(a, b) <= threshold`.
Count distinct final DSU roots, including values greater than `threshold` as isolated components.
Provide the complete `Solution.countComponents` implementation and validate its complexity and edge cases.
